_comment: The AI providers' request bodies, answers and error bodies (docs/mcp-enclave.md §18.9), pinned from B0 (§18.19): each `bodies` entry is a call B0 made and the provider accepted (`b0_request`, the media elided as B0 reported it, or `b0_form`), and `body` the exact JSON the enclave's builder sends for the same call with the small synthetic media of `media`. `errors` are B0's error bodies rebuilt from its reports (message and shape; ids synthetic), then the documented codes B0 could not provoke, with the error map's verdict each must get. `answers` are 200 answers shaped as B0's were (ids, signatures and text synthetic) and what §18.9's "Answers" make of each. Checked by test/ai-shapes.test.mjs. B0 sent the prompts of version 1; a body whose prompt has changed since (video/2, §18.20) says which version B0 sent (`b0_prompt_version`), and its `body` is the current one. No response id, key or account data of B0 is here.
